title: system-tests CI never exercises taint tracking (SQLi, CMDi, sources)
claim: The weblog only has weak hash/cipher routes, the SQLi/CMDi/source tests are missing_feature, and the CI gate only requires weak hash, weak cipher and dedup, so the branch's taint-tracking pipeline has no cross-tracer e2e coverage.

title: instrumented.source / executed.source telemetry never produced
claim: InstrumentedSource and ExecutedSource are never incremented by any production code or orchestrion.yml, so every source test_telemetry_metric_* test fails.

title: http.request.uri value is origin-form RequestURI, not the absolute URL
claim: The URI source value is '/iast/source/uri/test', while TestURI (all languages) expects 'http://host:port/path'. r.URL.String() is untainted, so no Go weblog can satisfy the test.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 ST_SHAPES_OUT=shapes.json go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestZZSystemTestsShapes . && python3 .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/check_shapes.py shapes.json <system-tests>/tests/appsec/iast/vulnerability_schema.json (harness files: .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/zz_systemtests_shape_test.go.txt, zz_systemtests_mux.go.txt, orchestrion.tool.go.txt)

title: Manifest enables TestWeakCipher_StackTrace/_ExtendedLocation for all Go weblogs
claim: The golang missing_feature entries for these two classes were removed and only TestWeakCipher got a weblog_declaration, so gin/echo/chi/net-http run them and fail.

title: Header source names are canonical MIME names
claim: Source names are 'Table'/'User' rather than the 'table'/'user' the tests intend. The tests pass only because of a source_name vs source_names typo in system-tests.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 ST_SHAPES_OUT=shapes.json go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestZZSystemTestsShapes . && python3 .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/check_shapes.py shapes.json <system-tests>/tests/appsec/iast/vulnerability_schema.json (harness files: .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/zz_systemtests_shape_test.go.txt, zz_systemtests_mux.go.txt, orchestrion.tool.go.txt)

title: Pointer-receiver location class format mismatches system-tests Go matcher
claim: dd-iast-go emits class 'pkg.(*T)' while the system-tests Go matcher builds 'pkg.*T', so stack/extended-location tests fail for vulnerabilities in pointer-receiver methods.

title: instrumented.* counts resubmitted every heartbeat; request.tainted always 0
claim: Build-time totals are submitted as count on every heartbeat (inflation), and RequestTainted is never incremented.

title: TestIastVulnerabilitySchema vacuous for Go; manifest comment stale
claim: Only meta _dd.iast.json is validated, while Go uses meta_struct iast whenever the agent supports it. The harness JSON events are all schema-VALID, but the msgpack path is never checked.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 ST_SHAPES_OUT=shapes.json go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestZZSystemTestsShapes . && python3 .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/check_shapes.py shapes.json <system-tests>/tests/appsec/iast/vulnerability_schema.json (harness files: .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/zz_systemtests_shape_test.go.txt, zz_systemtests_mux.go.txt, orchestrion.tool.go.txt)

title: TestMultipart (file part, servlet names) cannot pass
claim: File parts are intentionally not sources; keep the test missing_feature/irrelevant for Go.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 ST_SHAPES_OUT=shapes.json go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestZZSystemTestsShapes . && python3 .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/check_shapes.py shapes.json <system-tests>/tests/appsec/iast/vulnerability_schema.json (harness files: .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/zz_systemtests_shape_test.go.txt, zz_systemtests_mux.go.txt, orchestrion.tool.go.txt)

title: Propagation limited to root-module non-test packages constrains weblog/test authoring
claim: Weblog _shared packages are a non-root module, and a concat inside a root-module external _test.go package did not propagate in the harness.
repro_command: cd iast/integration/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 ST_SHAPES_OUT=shapes.json go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestZZSystemTestsShapes . && python3 .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/check_shapes.py shapes.json <system-tests>/tests/appsec/iast/vulnerability_schema.json (harness files: .omo/review/evidence/sink-systemtests/zz_systemtests_shape_test.go.txt, zz_systemtests_mux.go.txt, orchestrion.tool.go.txt)

title: CI depends on a mutable unmerged system-tests branch
claim: The default ref romain.marcadier/dd-iast-go is a branch name, not a SHA, and its weblog go.mod pins stale versions that the install script overrides.
